title: Relief Grooves for Grinding Zones and Thread
rules: Relief grooves for grinding zones must follow diameter-specific dimensional requirements compared to UNI4386 standard
Relief grooves for thread must be made in case where the thread zone ends at a shoulder with ledge function
Groove dimensions vary by diameter range: 18-50mm, 51-80mm, 81-125mm, and >125mm for grinding zones
Thread relief groove dimensions vary by pitch: P ≤ 1.25mm, P = 1.5-1.75-2mm, P = 2.5-3mm
Specific grooves must be indicated in details on drawing
Dashed lines indicate UNI regulation, solid lines indicate TRASMITAL specifications
dimensions: Grinding zone 18-50mm: width 2.5mm, depth 0.4mm, angle 30°, radii R 0.1 and 0.1
Grinding zone 51-80mm: width 3mm, depth 0.6mm, angle 30°, radii R 1.6 and 1.6
Grinding zone 81-125mm: width 4.5mm, depth 2.0mm, angle 30°, radii R 2.5 and 2.5
Grinding zone >125mm: width 7mm, depth 5.0-11mm, angle 30°, radii R4.0
tolerances: Grinding zone 18-50mm: ±0.1mm on width and depth
Grinding zone 51-80mm: ±0.2mm on width and depth
Grinding zone 81-125mm: ±0.3mm on width, ±0.4mm and ±2.5mm on depths
Thread relief groove: depth tolerance P~0.6÷13±3
inspection: Verify groove dimensions match specified diameter range
Check groove angle is 30° for grinding zones
Verify radius dimensions at groove transitions
Confirm groove depth and width within tolerance bands
manufacturing_notes: Relief grooves facilitate grinding operations by providing tool clearance
Thread relief grooves prevent interference at shoulder transitions
Groove geometry must allow grinding wheel exit
TRASMITAL specifications may differ from UNI standard - follow drawing callouts
Specific groove details must be indicated on manufacturing drawings when they differ from standard
training_guidance: NX agent should automatically add relief grooves when grinding zones terminate at shoulders
Select groove dimensions based on shaft diameter range: 18-50, 51-80, 81-125, or >125mm
For threaded features ending at shoulders with ledge function, add thread relief groove based on thread pitch
Model groove with 30° angle and specified radii for proper tool clearance
Apply dimensional tolerances based on diameter range
Flag design for detail callout when specific grooves are required
Use UNI4386 as baseline but apply TRASMITAL specifications where specified
Ensure groove depth provides adequate clearance for grinding wheel without weakening shaft
summary: This page defines two types of relief grooves: grinding zone relief grooves (TAB-001) with four diameter-based size ranges (18-50, 51-80, 81-125, >125mm), and thread relief grooves (TAB-002) with three pitch-based configurations. All grinding grooves use 30° angles with specific widths, depths, and radii. The standards reference both UNI regulation (dashed lines) and TRASMITAL specifications (solid lines), with requirements to detail specific grooves on drawings.
